pr_title: Fix osu!mania scores failing to convert to new standardised score due to cast failure
pr_body:
Regressed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/23917.
Closes #24217.

Haven't tested yet as I don't have a database ready to do so.

Of note, the reporting issue mentions this happened during a gameplay flow, which should definitely not be possible. If anyone has any ideas how this can happen, I'm all ears. We should definitely get to the bottom of that before pushing out the release.
pr_comments:
I've (re-)tested the following:

- The pathway that led newly-set scores to undergo conversion to new standardised should no longer be reachable (most easily tested by creating a single beatmap with one object on it and then setting a perfect score on it - on `master` it'll fail to import with the trace given in issue, on this branch it will not)
- Scores without score V2 mod set on stable are converted to new standardised
- Scores with score V2 mod set on stable are not converted to new standardised
- Scores from old lazer (pre-2023) are converted to new standardised
- Scores from slightly newer lazer (from 2023, which numerically match old standardised) are converted to new standardised
- Scores from new lazer (after merge of https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/23848) are not converted to new standardised

Everything but the first point was tested using the following replays: [score-test-cases.zip](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/12060896/score-test-cases.zip). Maybe I can adapt that to a test case or something...

Looks good to me, but given I've bungled this pretty bad overall, I'm probably not gonna click the button and see if maybe anyone wants to have a go reviewing... Or you can merge at your leisure if you think the above is sufficient testing I guess.

issue_context.title: Mania score cannot be import
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

Database import or population failed and has been rolled back.
System.InvalidCastException: Unable to cast object of type 'FakeHit' to type 'osu.Game.Rulesets.Mania.Objects.ManiaHitObject'.

Reproducibility method:
play mania once and you will get error message in result screen, fail the game and import score by button also can cause fail



### Screenshots or videos

![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/34775378/2b2624cd-4d63-4bb1-a1f2-ea0a33c18d01)


### Version

commit cdbb6f90be

### Logs

[database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/12047867/database.log)
[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/12047870/runtime.log)
comments: Thank you for your testing. This definitely saved us from a hotfix release.

review_comments: The problem with the second option is that for a user that may not have updated to the latest version when it was released, all their recent scores will be misidentified.
I've gone with option 1 due to above reasoning, and added inline commentary. Please check it makes sense.
